purpose: Author-reviewed correspondences between specification variableNames and names used in publicly available injection-moulding datasets and data repositories; a supplementary aid for source-specific conversion.

relationDefinitions.closeMatch: The public source evidence establishes a close match for the parameter concept. Source-specific phase, aggregation, sensor position or instance semantics may still differ. This is a source-name mapping and does not assert conformance with an external standard.
relationDefinitions.related: The source field is relevant to the canonical parameter but differs in role, aggregation, scope, unit or specificity and is not directly interchangeable.

curationPolicy.reviewStatus: All entries have been reviewed at least once by the specification author. Review does not imply resolved semantics or independent confirmation.
curationPolicy.reviewDates: Author-review dates are 2026-08-18 and 2026-10-09, as recorded per entry. The dates refer to source-evidence reviews; structural formatting and header expansion do not constitute additional independent reviews.

sources.title: Injection-Molding Production Data with Quality Labels (d-optimal Design of Experiment pattern)
sources.bibliographicCitation: Lambers, J., Krauß, J., Schüder, J., & Schömig, M. (2023). Injection-Molding Production Data with Quality Labels (d-optimal Design of Experiment pattern) [Data set]. B2SHARE v2. https://doi.org/10.23728/b2share.3f80952ce5ff4be88ae4cf6a3bdfe732
sources.note: ProBayes 2023 dataset with d-optimal design-of-experiment pattern. The archived Pandas_Profiling_Report.html exposes 310 variables. DataXplorer-Parameter_Names.xlsx is byte-identical across the ProBayes 2022 V1, 2022 V2 and 2023 dataset records; mappings from that artifact are assigned to this source ID unless a version-specific difference is documented.

sources.title: Injection-Molding Production Data with Quality Labels
sources.bibliographicCitation: Lambers, J., Schüder, J., & Krauß, J. (2022). Injection-Molding Production Data with Quality Labels [Data set]. Lambers, Jonathan. https://doi.org/10.23728/b2share.4c5692b886db419180f716acf895bf06
sources.note: ProBayes 2022 V2 dataset. The archived DatasetV2_Report_Minimal.html exposes 364 variables and includes fields not present in the 2023 profiling report, including SIM_* simulation features and additional dosing, dryer, infrared-image and set-value fields. Reviewed evidence: Version-specific Parquet schema and first row, 15-page description and DataXplorer dictionary; not an exhaustive value or array audit. Schema has 564 rows and 364 fields, whereas the description reports 334 features.

sources.title: Injection Molding Dataset (Viscometer, Euromap77, Quality Table)
sources.bibliographicCitation: Grunemann, T., & Schüder, J. (2025). Injection Molding Dataset (Viscometer, Euromap77, Quality Table) [Data set]. B2SHARE v2. https://doi.org/10.23728/b2share.d8502ea56c544e069ebda44c3edd441b
sources.note: B2SHARE dataset with 68 injection molding experiments, 17 unique machine settings and 4 repeated cycles per experiment. It contains machine setting parameters, EUROMAP77 values, quality-table values and time-resolved viscometer pressure data. Reviewed evidence: Headers, schemas and documentation of three tables; all 68 shared experiment/run pairs checked for three durations. Large pressure table was not exhaustively inspected.

sources.title: Experimental Dataset on Thermoset Injection Molding of a Phenolic Resin Compound
sources.bibliographicCitation: Ahlers, J., & Mascher, M. (2025). Experimental Dataset on Thermoset Injection Molding of a Phenolic Resin Compound [Data set]. RWTH Publications. https://doi.org/10.18154/RWTH-2025-00177
sources.note: RWTH dataset with 15 thermoset injection molding experiments on phenolic resin (Bakelite PF6680). The README defines p_S, V_S, v_S, p_C, deltaV, deltaP and C; the experimental TXT files contain time, v_S, V_S, p_S and p_C.

sources.title: Classification of Defective Parts in Injection Molding Using Various Machine Learning Approaches

sources.note: Public GitHub repository for classifying defective injection-molded parts using the KAMP dataset. Its README states 7,996 rows, 44 columns and the target label PassOrFail.

sources.title: Machine Learning for Quality Prediction in Plastic Injection Molding
sources.bibliographicCitation: Dataset and README accompanying Polenta et al. (2022), machine-learning-for-quality-prediction-in-plastic-injection-molding repository.
sources.note: Paper and accompanying Git repository comparing machine-learning techniques for quality classification of molded products. The README states that dataset/data.csv contains 1451 feature vectors with 13 injection-molding process parameters plus a quality label.

sources.title: Data Model for Injection Molding and Blow Molding
sources.bibliographicCitation: Lino Moreno, Smith Eusebio (2025), Data Model for Injection Molding and Blow Molding, Mendeley Data, V1, doi: 10.17632/gtnb4j7bfx.1
sources.note: Mendeley Data V1 spreadsheet titled Data Model for Injection Molding and Blow Molding. The publicly archived workbook modelo.xlsx contains a table with Spanish field names for production counts, rejected products, material consumption, cavity count and process values for injection molding and blow molding.

sources.title: Injection-Moulding-Dataset
sources.note: Public Foxconn Injection-Moulding-Dataset GitHub repository. Its README describes data_set.csv as machine process setting parameters, data_spc.csv as forming-machine status data, Size.csv as three labels per module and the zipped high-frequency sensor documentation as one CSV per mould/module. The inspected high-frequency ZIP entry is a Git LFS pointer; its data archive was not inspected.

sources.title: Cross-process-chain dataset archive: Combined data collection from injection molding and screw driving
sources.bibliographicCitation: West, Nikolai; Klute, Marco (2025). Cross-process-chain dataset archive: Combined data collection from injection molding and screw driving [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17240390
sources.note: Reviewed evidence: Injection-moulding static-table headers and three curve beginnings per workpiece stream (first, middle and last sorted files); six purposive samples, not all curves. Screw-driving fields are excluded.

sources.title: Plastic injection moulding with deliberately induced drying faults: a cycle-level industrial dataset from the Sirris laboratories
